question: Where and at what moment is the mind to be placed according to this prescription?
premises: The mind is to be placed in the circle in the nose.
It is also to be placed at the time of yawning.
inference: One should place the mind in the nasal circle and place it at the moment of yawning.
plain_english: One should place the mind in the circle of the nose; one should place it at the time of yawning.
